name: Mercenary Smoke Bomb
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Smoke Bomb (players/thief/mercenary/smoke_bomb_merc.sval, 25 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 3 (in brackets): stun 3.5 s (4 s); evasion 15% (30%); mana 60 (50). Its own mana 60 (50), cooldown 7 s. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon. Numbers are HoH1's, not this port's.
summary: The bomb stuns for 3.5 s and its cloud gives allies 15% evasion.
